page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred in places. Doubtful readings: "nostrûm" (possibly nostrum), the Greek words ἀναπόδεικτα and τὸ εἶναι, which are approximated from the print. The page ends mid-word with the hyphen "sin-", so the next page continues the word. No catchword is visible. Left-margin edge marks and show-through have been omitted.
